title: Florence Smith Nicholls: Object Biographies: An Archaeological Approach to PCG
speaker: Florence Smith Nicholls
talk_title: Object Biographies: An Archaeological Approach to PCG
description:
Through my doctoral studies I have coined the term generative archaeology games to refer to games with procedurally generated content that a player is encouraged to interpret and record archaeologically. In this talk, I will focus on the archaeological concept of object biographies, which broadly refers to the life cycle of an object through its interactions with other people and things.

Lead-in music generated by Sonat Uzun.
